scripts.check-bundle: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const files = fs.readdirSync('dist/assets'); let found = false; for (const file of files) { if (file.endsWith('.js')) { const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join('dist/assets', file), 'utf8'); if (content.includes('localhost:8080/api')) { console.error('Found localhost:8080/api in ' + file); found = true; } } } if (found) process.exit(1); console.log('Bundle check passed');"
